contract: A23-74 (user 2026-10-07 "점점 합쳐지겠다"): body radius = 1.5 x Scale (Slime shape) / 1.25 x Scale (Humanoid); a chaser's goal is its slot on a ring r + 1 + 1 (<= AttackRange - 0.5) around its target, centred 0.25 s ahead of a walking player (at most 4 studs); slots of one player's chasers spread (order kept, least movement) so ring neighbours stand rA + rB apart; when they do not fit, the inner ring moves out to AttackRange - 0.5 (10 Shard Slimes in reach) and the rest wait on further rings outside reach, each RingGap outside the bodies of the ring before (30 slimes: 10 + 18 + 2); a slot on water falls back to the player's position. In reach a monster stands for its swing (pending wind-up or cooldown up), within 0.5 of its slot or when the slot is inside the player body, else it steps on to its slot (AutoRotate off while in reach). After every AI tick the end points of the coming walks (_walkTo at WalkSpeed) are pushed apart in up to 3 rounds where bodies would overlap (rA + rB, the smaller one moving more, a boss never) or a body would be inside a player (r + 1 around where the player will be); each push becomes a slide over that tick at most 8 studs/s, never into water / past the zone move inset / through a wall (half step tried), and a walking monster's MoveTo point moves along; pushes under 0.05 are ignored; neighbours come from an 8-stud grid; a new monster spawns at least rA + rB + 1.5 from every living one, else the first crowded ground point; SpawnEvent (bosses) keeps the same clearance within its radius, else its spot (the slides clear it). Review probe: walking 3 / 5 / 8 studs/s with 4 Shard + 2 King Slimes, mean deepest overlap per AI tick < 0.3 studs. Monster parts stay CanCollide = false.
limitations: Roots, Humanoids (MoveTo / WalkSpeed / AutoRotate), the ground ray, walls, Random and the player list are doubles; the simulations use a stand-in for aiStep / attack (walk at Def.Speed x the NATURAL ramp, a wind-up of MonsterWindup s, a Humanoid that stops once it reached its MoveTo point) around the real SEP passes. Real Humanoid MoveTo / AutoRotate behaviour, replication smoothness of the server slides, the FACE turn while stepping sideways and the Tripo mesh footprints are only checkable in Studio Play (game dev 1). SEP.Need sorting ties by id (like Spread) is asserted but has no mutation: Luau's table.sort happens to order the test ties the same way with an angle-only comparator.
